title: Kessler Syndrome and Orbital Space Debris
executive_summary: Kessler Syndrome is a scenario in which the density of objects in Low Earth Orbit (LEO) becomes high enough that collisions produce a cascading chain reaction, creating exponential space debris that renders orbits unusable. This topic provides an essential, rigorous framework for understanding Kessler Syndrome and Orbital Space Debris within modern astrophysics, space exploration, and theoretical physics.
